tier: Promo VPS Saver LA BF / NY BF

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The Black Friday page read today sells 'Promo VPS Saver LA BF' and 'Promo VPS Saver NY BF' at USD 9.88 a year for 1 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 10 GB SSD, 1 TB and 1 IPv4; the same shape is USD 2.99 a month on the promo page.

retention.stated: The server persists while the term is paid. The billing portal is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so no deletion schedule was read.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month on the Saver plan at 1 Gbps, in the vendor's spelling '1 TB Bandwith'.

interface_detail: KVM guest with root access, Virtualizor panel, one IPv4.
tooling: Any SSH client; KVM, so the guest runs its own kernel.
chaining: The only IPv4 machine found under USD 12 a year: a 1 GB KVM guest in Buffalo or Los Angeles for USD 9.88, which can hold a WireGuard listener on a public IPv4 that IPv4-only peers can reach.

limits.value: 1 TB a month on the Saver plan

binding_note: 1 TB a month is the first hard number; the 1 GB shape limits concurrency but has no monthly clock on it.

notes: This is the only sub-USD-1 row found in the whole lane with a dedicated IPv4, and it is also the cheapest 1 GiB machine with one: USD 0.82 a month on annual prepay, USD 9.88 out of pocket. A dedicated IPv4 removes the UDP-forwarding question entirely, and KVM means the guest's own kernel can load the wireguard module instead of a userspace wireguard-go build. What weakens it: the price is a Black Friday campaign page still served in October, the renewal is not published, and the seller's named entity 'Dedi Rock LLC' is not in the Florida register. Not established: whether a host firewall filters UDP; whether the USD 9.88 renews at the same rate; the payment rails and any card hold.

extras.term: 1 year at USD 9.88, or 1 month at USD 2.99
extras.price_arithmetic: USD 9.88 a year / 12 = USD 0.8233 a month, paid once. The monthly SKU is USD 2.99 a month. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same.

network_out.ports: all, on one dedicated IPv4; no NAT forwarding layer exists on this plan

extras.payment_rails: Visa, MC, Amex, Discover, PayPal, Bitcoin, cheque; Stripe on the cart
extras.under_one_dollar: only on the annual prepay: USD 9.88 a year / 12 = USD 0.8233 a month, paid once, on a Black Friday SKU
extras.promo_note: the annual SKU carries a Black Friday name and a '-bf' product code and is not linked from the monthly offer page; no renewal price is published for either SKU
extras.udp: not stated on any page read, and no page states a UDP restriction. The plan carries a dedicated IPv4 with no port-forwarding layer, so there is no forwarding rule that could omit UDP; a host-side firewall could still filter it and that was not tested.
extras.virtualization: KVM (Virtualizor panel), so the guest runs its own kernel and the in-kernel WireGuard module
